services.name: Set sail
services.desc: The most popular way to spend an evening on the water. Time your cruise for golden hour and watch the light go warm over Alamitos Bay while you take it easy at the helm. There is a window in the late afternoon when Alamitos Bay goes quiet and the light turns everything amber. Pour a drink, cue up something easy on the stereo, and point the boat west. With up to 10 aboard it is just as good for a date as it is for a group of friends, and the canals are right there if you want to wind through the neighborhood on the way back. services.name: Paddleboards
services.desc: Out for a paddle on the calm water of Alamitos Bay. No reservation needed: come down to the dock and get on the water. Some days you want the whole crew on a Duffy. Other days you want the water to yourself, a board under your feet, and nowhere to be. Alamitos Bay and the Naples canals are calm and protected, which makes them an easy, scenic place to paddle past the waterfront homes and out toward the open bay. services.desc: One quiet electric boat, the whole of Alamitos Bay, and the Naples canals just around the bend. However you want to spend the afternoon, it starts the same way: step off the dock at Marina Pacifica and take the water at your own pace. Here is how people like to do it. Time your cruise for golden hour and watch the light turn the bay to gold. Our favorite way to spend an evening on the water. Glide through the Naples canals past the waterfront homes and the little bridges. Calm water, big views, at your own pace.
